$$\ce{CH3CO-CoA + 3NAD+ + GDP + PO4^{3-} + 2H2O -> CoA-SH + 3NADH + 3H+ + GTP + 2CO2}$$

According to the given reaction, what type of reaction does this reaction belong to?
